You brace as a brief shimmer of scales catches the light across your arms.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, before taking fire or physical damage.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Scales flare across your skin. Gain resistance 3 to one of those types for this event only, using the highest matching value. No stacking with armor.
